testcase.name: Scenario: Align the model browser and viewport to the workspace frame: tmp/obk-workspace-4066/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:38:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Align the model browser and viewport to the workspace frame ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is docked at the left ✔ When the user inspects the workspace boundaries ✔ Then the model browser begins at the left content edge directly below the ribbon ✔ And the viewport begins at the browser's shared divider without an empty gutter ✔ And the viewport fills the remaining content width ✔ And the ribbon, browser, viewport and status area use aligned outer edges

testcase.name: Scenario: Align the document tabs with the viewport instead of the browser: tmp/obk-workspace-4066/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:59:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Align the document tabs with the viewport instead of the browser ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is docked at the left ✔ When the user inspects the bottom workspace rows ✔ Then the browser extends to the status area above the bottom row ✔ And the document tab strip begins at the viewport's left edge ✔ And the document tab strip ends at the viewport's right edge ✔ And no document tabs appear below the model browser ✔ And the status area spans the full application width
